name: Cairns Airport

runway.v: one runway, 15/33, 45 m wide, up to 3,196 m take-off run (RWY 33; 3,156 m from 15)

ppr.v: all non-airline aircraft over 5,700 kg need prior parking approval from Cairns Airport, 48 hours notice, phone 07 4080 6744 (24 hours), because of a critical shortage of apron space
ppr.quote: all non-RPT ACFT ABV 5,700KG and rotary wing

max_aircraft.v: aircraft with wingspan over 36 m must use the turn pads; several taxiways are weight-limited (A3 not above 23,000 kg, A4 not above 90,000 kg); GA apron taxilane wingspan limits are marked on site
max_aircraft.quote: ACFT with wingspan ABV 36M must use turn pads at RWY ends.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 24 hours on the airline aprons (Viva Energy); Air BP 2000-0800 UTC daily (Avgas, Jet A-1), after hours with 1 hour notice and a call-out fee; Viva on the GA apron Mon-Fri 1900-0800 UTC, Sat-Sun 1930-0800 UTC
fuel.quote: RPT domestic/international aprons H24. JET A1.

noise.v: noise abatement procedures apply (AIP DAP); circuit training by jets and aircraft over 5,700 kg not permitted 22:00-07:00 local
noise.quote: Circuit training by jet ACFT and other ACFT exceeding 5,700KG MTOW is not permitted BTN 2200-0700 Local.

handling.v: marshalling is required for all charter and visiting aircraft on the domestic and international aprons; the airport does not provide it; two FBOs list 24-hour ground handling
handling.quote: Aircraft marshalling is required for all charter and visiting aircraft using the Domestic and International aprons.

missing: curfew (no aerodrome hours or curfew line on the ERSA page)
customs (only a phone number for international flights: 07 4052 3551/4052 3552; no hours)
notes: Apron space is short: ask for parking 48 hours ahead for any jet over 5,700 kg. Rescue and fire cover CAT 8 H24. Handler names recorded on the ERSA page are not copied to the website. Read 24 Nov 2026 from Airservices Australia ERSA pages (FAC and RDS, the latest pages found).
